title: Sloe Berry Tagine
description: A traditional Kenyan-inspired dessert with a twist of warm spices and a sweet berry sauce.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg

instructions: Mix sloe berries, tagine spice blend, brown sugar, and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, egg, and vanilla extract. Add the mixture to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a greased tagine or baking dish.
Dot the top with unsalted butter, if using.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional sloe berries and tagine spice blend, if desired.
